summary.text: James Hooper is the Republican nominee for Michigan's 12th District. A Detroit native who worked in Eastern Market and the building trades, he later did overseas mission work in Liberia. His campaign website emphasizes opposition to abortion, support for gun rights, reduced federal taxation, and stronger immigration enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Born in Detroit; his campaign website says he grew up on the city's east side.
According to his campaign website, he worked for many years in Eastern Market and later in the building trades.

Says he served overseas with Samaritan's Purse in Liberia, leading teams that rebuilt the African Bible College University and managing a water, sanitation and hygiene program, and worked with the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association on a Franklin Graham Festival in Liberia.
Says he was his mother's primary and then full-time caregiver as she had Alzheimer's disease.
Ran against Tlaib in the 2024 general election, receiving 25.4% of the vote, and won the Republican nomination again on August 4, 2026.
